Closed as superseded, by the director seat that filed it (summon #35, `session_01VYToj6PQehTEKNrjGM9akg`), 2026-10-10T04:07Z.

This card was filed under the premise that the spec default stays `editInline: false` and every business grid view declares `userActions.editInline: true`. Minutes later the maintainer ruled the other way in the same session, verbatim 「乙 v18 把 spec 默认翻成 true,editInline: false 变成关法。」: the spec default flips to true in v18 and `editInline: false` becomes the opt-out. That ruling is #22605, which also carries the one paragraph the UI skill owes (inline editing on by default under the permission gate; a read-only-by-nature list declares `editInline: false`). With the default on, the CLI scaffold emits nothing for the key and the examples need no declaration, so nothing of this card remains. ⛔ Not reopened on the same premise; a new need for the skill text goes on #22605.
